chunks: He said: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind me just as I see you from before me and from in front of me. And do not differ, lest Allah cause disagreement among your hearts."

key_terms.تُخَالِفُوا: Do not differ or act in opposition
key_terms.صُفُوفَكُمْ: Your prayer rows in congregational salat

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about straightening rows in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله instructs the believers to straighten their rows in congregational salat. The hadith emphasizes outward order in worship and warns that discord in visible practice may lead to discord in the hearts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1139 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind me just as I see you from in front of me and from before me. Do not differ, lest Allah (swt) cause discord among your hearts."
